title: Chapter 196 Destroy The Immortal Soul Sect
content:
Chapter 196 Destroy The Immortal Soul Sect

Looking at Yan Lingyun, whose aura was terrifying in the void, everyone in the Immortal Soul Sect was trembling wildly at this moment.

Why?

Why would a strong man at the peak of the Immortal Emperor Realm appear here?

Isn't this kind of strong man only found in the Central Region?

While everyone in the Immortal Soul Sect was terrified, they were also puzzled in their hearts.

And at this moment, an illusory figure suddenly condensed slowly from above the Immortal Soul Sect.

"Sir, I don't recognize you. Is there some misunderstanding between us?"

The phantom was the ancestor of the Immortal Soul Sect.

In front of Yan Lingyun, the voice of the ancestor of the Immortal Soul Sect seemed very kind, as if he was so easy to talk to.

"Misunderstanding?"

Hearing the words of the ancestor of the Immortal Soul Sect, Yan Lingyun sneered.

The smile was extremely cold, like a thousand-year-old black ice.

"Wanfeng is my apprentice. Do you think there is still a misunderstanding between us?"

As soon as these words came out, the entire Immortal Soul Sect showed a puzzled look.

Wanfeng, who is this?

However, one person in the Immortal Soul Sect showed a look of shock and disbelief.

It was the Immortal Soul Sect Patriarch.

Others did not know the name Wan Feng, but how could the Immortal Soul Sect Patriarch not know it.

"You, you,"

At this moment, the Immortal Soul Sect Patriarch showed a trace of fear in his heart.

Unexpectedly, the Crazy Emperor was already terrifying enough, and there was someone behind him who was even more terrifying than the Crazy Emperor.

Without hesitation, the Immortal Soul Sect Patriarch turned around and fled.

Swish!

The space cracked, and the Immortal Soul Sect Patriarch escaped into the void and disappeared from everyone's eyes in an instant.

Ran away.

"Old, the ancestor ran away..."

An Immortal Soul Sect elder saw this scene and immediately collapsed on the ground.

The other Immortal Soul Sect strongmen did not move, but their faces were also extremely ugly.

The Immortal Soul Sect Patriarch did not even have the slightest idea of resistance, and ran away directly. What that meant, they knew very well.

At this time, another elder of the Immortal Soul Sect stood up, looking at Yan Lingyun in the void and tremblingly said: "This senior, you are a strong man at the peak of the Immortal Emperor Realm. Looking at the entire Wood Immortal Realm, you are an invincible existence in the world. Please spare my Immortal Soul Sect. We were not involved in your apprentice's affairs back then."

At the same time, all the elders and disciples of the entire Immortal Soul Sect looked at Yan Lingyun, their eyes full of desire to survive.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng, who was beside Yan Lingyun, looked strange and turned his head slightly to look at Yan Lingyun.

If it were him, he would have incorporated this sect.

This is his usual style.

He rarely did things like killing everyone.

At this moment, he wanted to see what Yan Lingyun would do.

"Don't worry, your ancestor is dead, as for you, I will let you accompany her on the road."

It was still the same cold words.

Like a sharp blade, it pierced through the last bit of luck in the hearts of all the Xianhun Sect masters present.

"Ah!! In that case, let's fight her!"

A Xianhun Sect master of the seventh level of the Xianhun Realm roared.

Since there is no possibility of survival, let's fight to the death.

Suddenly, the entire Xianhun Sect was boiling.

At this moment, the strength of the Xianhun Sect was completely revealed.

There were two Xianhun Realm late masters. Counting the Xianhun Sect ancestor who had already fled, the Xianhun Sect had three Xianhun Realm late masters.

With such strength, it's no wonder that they dared not take any force in the Wood Immortal Realm seriously.

Not to mention the other Xianhun Realm masters in the Xianhun Sect.

Seeing this scene, Lu Daosheng retracted his thoughts and looked at the countless Xianhun Sect masters who were already fighting towards the two of them. He saw that Lu Daosheng raised his hand slightly, and a force condensed from Lu Daosheng's hand.

Click!

As soon as this force appeared, the surrounding fairyland space began to be turbulent and cracked.

At this time, a soft jade hand rested on Lu Daosheng's arm.

"Let me do it."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng was slightly stunned, and the power in his hand dissipated immediately.

Yan Lingyun looked cold and took a step forward.

Boom!

Suddenly, the entire void could no longer withstand the external force and completely collapsed.

At the same time, the strong fluctuations directly shook away all the strong men of the Immortal Soul Sect who were killing the two.

And the entire Immortal Soul Sect was directly turned into a ruin at this moment.

"The Immortal Soul Sect, from now on, no longer exists!"

Yan Lingyun shouted coldly, and the terrifying power surged out of Yan Lingyun's body again.

Looking at the irresistible terrifying power, the people of the Immortal Soul Sect were completely desperate.

For a moment, the Immortal Soul Sect regretted it.

Unfortunately, everything was too late.

After a long time, Lu Daosheng and Yan Lingyun stood calmly in the void.

Below, the once glorious Immortal Soul Sect has now become a ruin, with no vitality.

Looking closely, the past scenes even seem to reappear, as if nothing has happened.

But the truth is that from today on, the Immortal Soul Sect has completely disappeared in the long river of history.

"Daosheng, do you think I am cruel?"

At this time, Yan Lingyun suddenly asked.

Hearing this question, Lu Daosheng shook his head, "No matter what choice you make, I will support you."

"Remember, you are not alone, and I am behind you."

It was not a wrong decision to destroy the entire Immortal Soul Sect.

There is always a price to pay for doing something wrong.

Looking at Yan Lingyun's calm face, Lu Daosheng slowly reached out and touched her.

He knew that Yan Lingyun's living environment was not very good since she was a child.

The family admires the strong.

Yan Lingyun, who had never been valued, chose to practice desperately and work hard.

She paid unimaginable hardships for her peers.

In the end, she finally became one of the strongest in the family.

But what was the result?

After working hard for half a lifetime, she was still abandoned by the family.

From that moment on, Ye Lingzhi, who only wanted to get anything from the family and feel a little affection, died completely.

"Daosheng, thank you."

Yan Lingyun showed a faint smile.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng laughed, "What should we do now, that guy ran away."

"Run away, that's really a pity."

Yan Lingyun sighed, shook her head slightly, and looked very annoyed.

As if she was careless.

The two walked slowly towards the ruins of the Immortal Soul Sect below, hand in hand.

"Where do you think that old guy will run to?"

"Well, "

Yan Lingyun pondered for a moment, and then said: "It should be the Central Region. Now that the Immortal Soul Sect has been destroyed, he has no worries."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng smiled without saying anything.

And an extremely obscure breath in the dark suddenly trembled for a moment.

At this time, Lu Daosheng smiled slowly: "Lingyun, do you think that old guy is still here?"

As soon as this was said, Yan Lingyun also smiled.

"That's indeed possible."

Bang!

At this time, Yan Lingyun suddenly attacked without any warning.

The terrifying fist print mixed with endless fairy light went towards the underground of the Immortal Soul Sect.

In an instant, a huge and hideous hole was pierced through and completely exposed to the air.

With a whoosh.

See, a ray of black light flew out from the underground hole, and the breath was a little weak.

"You, are you kidding me?!"
